title: Reactions: a fixed set, on the wire and in the journal
spec: push::REACTIONS is the fixed set Like, Heart, Laugh, Surprised, Sad, Angry (code n = REACTIONS[n-1]; words, since the bundled font has no emoji). Request 17 React { room, target, reaction, on } answered Ok with the cursor of the reaction's own event; push 72 Reacted { room, cursor, target, author, reaction, on }; both refuse a code outside the set and an on byte other than 0 or 1. FEATURE_REACTIONS (16). RoomService::react: NotMember, NotAllowed for a Guest, BadReaction, NoSuchMessage for a missing or deleted target; appends EventKind::Reacted even when it changes nothing; reactions(target) gives who reacted, by code; a deleted message keeps none. Recorded as Op::React (tag 19), replayed after a restart; rate limited as edit. On Sync a client without FEATURE_REACTIONS gets Other in its place (still advancing the cursor). The client inbox applies Reacted as an event and keeps who reacted (RoomView::reactions) only when it was applied. The network server advertises FEATURE_REACTIONS.
